comment: Declarative manifest of palmux-managed components for the self-update feature (S6ab0ed). CORE entries (palmux binary + palmux-ws image) are always checked. tool entries are ONLY the ones declared here — palmux does not auto-discover host tooling. Each entry: name, kind (core-binary | core-image | tool), display, githubRepo (owner/repo for the GitHub Releases poll), source (free-text label shown in the panel). installed-version probing is wired in Go per kind.
